## Summary / 摘要

<!-- What changed and why? / 改了什么，为什么？ -->

## Verification / 验证

<!-- List commands actually run and their results, including failures and skips. / 列出实际运行的命令和结果，包括失败与跳过。 -->

- [ ] Python tests / Python 测试
- [ ] Standalone C# tests / 独立 C# 测试
- [ ] Repository hygiene check / 仓库检查
- [ ] Unity PlayMode or manual UI checks, when relevant / 相关时完成 Unity PlayMode 或手动界面检查
- [ ] OpenVSP integration, when relevant / 相关时完成 OpenVSP 集成验证

## Review checklist / 审查清单

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring. / 改动聚焦，无无关重构。
- [ ] English and Chinese user documentation are synchronized. / 中英文用户文档已同步。
- [ ] Both FlightDynamics source copies remain synchronized. / 两份 FlightDynamics 源码保持同步。
- [ ] No generated files, local paths, credentials, personal data, or telemetry are included. / 不包含生成物、本机路径、凭据、个人数据或遥测。
- [ ] New third-party content has documented author, source, and redistribution license. / 新第三方内容已记录作者、来源和再分发许可。
- [ ] Unrun checks are explicitly marked as not run. / 未运行的检查已明确标注。
